name: lead_p2b
setup: set -e; python3 -m venv /opt/p2venv; /opt/p2venv/bin/pip install -q torch==2.7.0 numpy tokenizers==0.21.1 transformers==4.51.3 safetensors matplotlib pytest; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.data.prepare --download --splits train_10M,train_100M,dev; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -x babylm/tests; if [ -n "${RESTORE_URI:-}" ]; then mkdir -p babylm/runs; gsutil -m -q rsync -r "$RESTORE_URI" babylm/runs; fi

jobs.name: port_S_10M_e10_s1
jobs.cmd: /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_gpu_p2.json --only port_S_10M_e10_s1; rc=$?; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.analysis.post_runs --pt_runs port_S_10M_e10_s0 port_S_10M_e10_s1 port_S_10M_e10_s2; exit $rc
